title: Grammar: Put a day, date and time together
subtitle: Unit 6: Days, time and appointments

steps.title: Put a day, date and time together
steps.body: Use le before a date, and à before a clock time. A schedule that shows opening and closing uses de ... à ....

steps.title: A simple schedule
rows: the appointment is Tuesday, April 14, at 9:30
Le rendez-vous est mardi, le 14 avril, à 9 h 30.

steps.title: Put a day, date and time together
steps.body:
• Without le, mardi can name one Tuesday: Le rendez-vous est mardi. With le, le mardi can mean every Tuesday: La clinique est ouverte le mardi.
• Read a schedule from left to right: first the day or date, then the time. Repeat all three when you confirm an appointment.
• Use de ... à ... for a time range: La réception est ouverte de 8 h à 16 h.

steps.prompt: Write each date in French words.  April 14
steps.explain: The answer is le quatorze avril.

steps.prompt: Write each date in French words.  May 1
steps.explain: The answer is le premier mai.

steps.prompt: Write each date in French words.  March 3
steps.explain: The answer is le trois mars.

steps.prompt: Write each date in French words.  June 2
steps.explain: The answer is le deux juin.

steps.prompt: Write each schedule time in French words.  9 h 30
steps.explain: The answer is neuf heures trente.

steps.prompt: Write each schedule time in French words.  14 h
Write each schedule time in French words.  12 h
Write each schedule time in French words.  16 h 15
steps.explain: The answer is seize heures quinze.
